criteria.requirement: Add mutating Box.rename_key(old, new) returning self. Rename a literal existing key at exactly its original insertion position, preserve value/sub-Box identity and configuration without recasting or reconversion, and update safe-attribute lookup. Reject missing old keys, existing targets, protected attributes, safe-alias collisions and frozen mutation before changing any data; old==new is an unchanged success for mutable boxes. Preserve integer keys and ordinary assignment semantics.
